description:
Approved as step 4 of /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.146.html (user, 2026-11-13). Needs fz-sc8.127 (#469), fz-sc8.155 (#473) and fz-sc8.156 (#474) on one base; build after they merge.

On that combined stack the compile of tools/distill-telemetry.exs finishes on interp, run and build with the default PRODUCT_DRIVE_BUDGET of 50,000 (50,249 requests summed over all sessions; root session about 48,800). Nothing in the suite compiles the distiller, so a change that pushes it back over the budget is silent until someone runs it by hand.

Change: one test compiles tools/distill-telemetry.exs through the production path and pins the root session's request count (observed through pull.product.requested telemetry), so a rise is loud and a fall is lowered. Until fz-sc8.3 lands the program fails at run time in Distill.fmt_ms/1, so the test stops after the compile settles; when the distiller runs end to end the test compares its output with tests/distill_telemetry expectations instead (fz-sc8.19).

Done when: the test fails on a base without any one of the three changes and passes with all three.
title: A test holds the distiller's compile inside the request budget
